kind: Component-zone captures for the HomeTemplate v0.1 draft specification (zone choreography states of the original Pulso page)
task: odd/tasks/web-catalog.md, H2 (web catalog layer f, S1-S4 and S6)
purpose: Observed evidence of the original source choreography states the HomeTemplate draft promises: one isotipo traveling between anchors, non-overlapping outgoing/incoming layer handoff, ambient profiles (read/live/calma), per-zone 3D scenes, the mobile chapter gate and the reduced-motion nearest-zone frame. These are read-only source captures: proposed design evidence, NOT approved expected design and NOT verification of any design-system implementation.
status: Proposed / Observed (not adopted; spec approval would need to identify these VIS IDs explicitly)

files.role: Captured page; template markers resolved ONLY in the harness copy below

Filled harness copy kept under the capture directory; identical to the source except the 14 template markers below, which resolve to read-only local assets by absolute file:// URLs; no effect math, style or content altered
Zone table, band math, layer gating, mobile and reduced-motion rules; read, never executed or modified
Per-zone pose formulas, anchor-box projection and canvas mask; read, never executed or modified
Documented frame order, zone table, director rules and props; read, not captured
Schematic preview map only; NOT the real frame and not captured as evidence of page appearance

conditions.browser: Google Chrome 148.0.7778.167, headless new, CDP-driven; WebGL via SwiftShader
conditions.theme: dark (source page defines its own dark palette; no prefers-color-scheme dependence observed)
conditions.fonts: document.fonts.status was "loaded" (settled FontFaceSet) at capture time; per-family availability of each requested webfont (Barlow, Barlow Condensed, JetBrains Mono) was NOT individually verified, so family-level absence cannot be excluded from these captures.
conditions.webfontsNetwork: three@0.160.0 loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net exactly as the source page requests; if unavailable the source falls back to per-slot SVG
conditions.crop: full viewport (the template spans the whole viewport; zone choreography is a page-level state)
conditions.scrollMethod: behavior:'instant' programmatic scrolls; the source sets scroll-behavior:smooth on html (pulso-source.html:27), which animated earlier attempts
conditions.viewportCaveat: the extracted source HTML carries no viewport meta, so mobile-DEVICE emulation reports a 980px layout viewport; the <=760px gate was exercised with a 390px desktop-style layout viewport (real phones without the meta would report the same 980px layout viewport)
conditions.reducedMotion: VIS-10 records the observed rm:true runtime flag and one static frame at capture time; temporal staticness over a duration was NOT observed. The no-further-frames expectation is source-read (pulso-iso3d.mjs reduced-motion branch), not an observed duration.

limits: SwiftShader WebGL: renders real scene content but is not a GPU; pixel parity with hardware rendering is not claimed.
Source-only global state (window.PULSO, html.gl-on/gl-off/gl-mob, data-fx on <html>) is observed evidence of the original page, not an approved design-system API.
No exact pixel-parity, manual-accessibility or zoom claims are made; captures do not verify behavior or accessibility.

Captures show the ORIGINAL web; the design-system composition (public AmbientBackground/Isotipo3D/ScrollReveal plus a new template) is expected to differ in implementation and is governed by its own gates.
FontFaceSet "loaded" does not prove each requested family resolved; no per-family check was recorded.
The reduced-motion capture is a single screenshot with the rm flag observed; it is not temporal proof of a static engine loop.
Full-source HTML is a local-only generated reconstruction excluded from Git; captures, helper and provenance metadata are the reviewable artifacts.
The current helper includes later safety hardening; source screenshots were not regenerated after it. The post-fix refusal check verifies preservation, not a fresh capture run.
